label: The Villainess Wakes
summary: You wake up as the villainess of a romance novel, one year before she is exiled. You know the plot. Can you change the ending?
title: The Villainess Wakes
description: You fell asleep reading The Rose of Rosaline and woke up as its villainess, the duke's daughter engaged to the Crown Prince and doomed to be exiled at the spring ball. You remember every scene. The heroine has just arrived at the royal academy, the prince is already cold to you, and the first big scene, the one where the villainess pours tea on the heroine, is tomorrow.

chapterOutlines.title: Waking Up
chapterOutlines.outline: Realize where you are, and what happens to you in a year.

chapterOutlines.title: The Tea Party
chapterOutlines.outline: Face the scene where the villainess humiliates the heroine, and do something else.

chapterOutlines.title: Off the Page
chapterOutlines.outline: Events start going in directions the novel never wrote.

chapterOutlines.title: The Spring Ball
chapterOutlines.outline: Arrive at the ball where the book ends, and write your own ending.

scene.location: A canopied bed in the duke's townhouse in the capital, at dawn
scene.summary: Silk sheets, a maid curtsying at the door and a mirror showing a face you know from the novel's cover. The villain's face. Yours.

openThreads: Why is the heroine acting differently than in the book?

npcs.name: Crown Prince Adrian
npcs.description: The novel's male lead, perfect and cold. In the book he never smiles at the villainess. He has started watching you strangely.

npcs.name: Lily Marsh
npcs.description: The novel's sweet, kind heroine, a commoner scholarship student. She is not as innocent as the book said, or she is much kinder.

npcs.name: Anna
npcs.description: Your loyal maid, who has served the villainess since childhood and is astonished that you just said thank you.

npcs.name: Sir Cedric Vale
npcs.description: Your family's knight and bodyguard, a minor character in the book who dies in the last chapter. Quiet, steady and always there.
goals: Never let you see what he feels

items.name: The novel in your memory
items.description: You remember the whole plot, scene by scene, up to the ending you want to avoid.
